incarnation: Iron Tempest — Mara Veylan current selected individual V2 portrait, original project canon2026
sourceLimits: Original project character, no external publisher/canon reference: currently selected HEROES_DB V2 portrait is the internal visual authority.
Exact eye color, tiny insignia, unseen back construction, hidden parts of harness/carbine and chronological age are not fully specified by one pixel-art view; no perfect1:1 certification.
World backdrop is environment-only; no identity reference inferred from other soldiers or shared props.
Existing selected atlas has long brown ponytail, darker close-fit costume and no carbine; retained unchanged as historical variant, not the V2 identity source.
New locations and poses are original compositions consistent with documented Iron Tempest lore, not official screenshots.
CG05 Nexus gameplay adaptation; CG09-11 Fan Art; CG12-15 What If; CG13genderSwap; CG15firstStep at same apparent age, no invented childhood.
